request: Owner: «эти иконки довольно странные, убери иконки, это показатель ИИ-слопа», then «Так я вроде сказал про ребрендинг иконок, давай делать, давай сделаем их в стиле той мозаики» — the Florentine pietra dura of the Instagram highlight covers (design/social/instagram/highlights/pietra-dura). Then: «только на гайдах и визе» — the icons live on the guide and visa pages only; the home page and the cabinet keep cells without icons. Then: «оставь только мозаичную структуру и сами элементы без кружков, а то кружки ассоциируются с ИИ-слопом» — the objects alone, in the same inlaid stone, without the disc and ring. Then, with two photos of Italian tessera mosaics (a Friul mosaic panel and the floor of the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II): «Сделай их реально похожими на мозаику». The objects are now laid in square tesserae; the photos were not uploaded, the style is described in words.
model: Higgsfield gpt_image_2_6, quality high, 1k, 1:1, transparent background (the model of the Instagram covers, so the stone matches)
template: The same {object} as in the first reference, remade as a real Italian floor mosaic: the whole object is built only from small square tesserae — white Carrara marble, honey-gold glass smalti with a slight shine, terracotta red, deep green and a little cream — hand-cut, slightly irregular squares laid in rows that follow the contours of each shape (opus vermiculatum), with thin light-grey grout lines visible between every tile. A row of dark brown tesserae outlines the whole object. Chunky tesserae: about 16 tiles across the object, so the mosaic still reads when the icon is small. Show ONLY the object made of tesserae, isolated on a transparent background: no background field, no disc, no circle, no frame. The object fills about 85% of the square, centred, front view. Even soft light, no cast shadow. No text, no letters, no numbers. (Redos add: EVERY surface is laid in clearly visible small square tesserae, no smooth stone areas and no marble veining anywhere.)
processing: crop to alpha (>4 %), centred on a transparent square plus 6 px; master WebP q92 in design/illustrations/source/mosaic/; site WebP q86 with alpha at 112 and 224 px (shown at 44–52 px).
